// Compile-only readiness consumer, never a native/self-hosting acceptance oracle.
use syntax_complete::{
    SyntaxNode,
    ast::{self, AstNode},
};
fn round<'t, N: AstNode<'t>>(n: N, node: SyntaxNode<'t>) {
    let _ = N::can_cast(node.kind());
    let _ = N::cast(node);
    let _ = n.syntax();
    let _ = n.syntax(); // inherited Copy
}
fn find<'t, N: AstNode<'t>>(node: SyntaxNode<'t>) -> Option<N> {
    node.children().find_map(N::cast)
}
fn all<'t>(root: SyntaxNode<'t>) {
    // GENERATED_INTERFACES
    let _ = find::<ast::Expr<'t>>(root);
    let _ = find::<ast::Type<'t>>(root);
    if let Some(x) = ast::IfExpr::cast(root) {
        let _ = x.condition();
        let _ = x.then_branch();
        let _ = x.else_branch();
    }
    if let Some(x) = ast::WhileExpr::cast(root) {
        let _ = x.condition();
        let _ = x.loop_body();
    }
    if let Some(x) = ast::ForExpr::cast(root) {
        let _ = x.iterable();
        let _ = x.loop_body();
    }
    if let Some(x) = ast::Impl::cast(root) {
        let _ = x.trait_ty();
        let _ = x.self_ty();
    }
    if let Some(x) = ast::PathSegment::cast(root) {
        let _ = x.self_ty();
        let _ = x.trait_ty();
    }
}
fn main() {
    for text in [
        "fn f(){if true {} else {};while false{}for x in 0..1{} }",
        "struct S; impl Trait for S {fn f(){}} fn g(){<S as Trait>::f();}",
        "fn broken( { if true {",
        "impl { fn x( ; while { for in } < as >::",
        "",
    ] {
        let p = syntax_complete::parse_source_file(text);
        let _ = p.errors();
        let _ = p.source_file().items().count();
        all(p.root());
        for node in p.root().descendants() {
            all(node);
        }
    }
}
